newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Goldfields holds net profit forecast.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Goldfields holds net profit forecast.

text.p: Goldfields Ltd chairman Tony Cotton said on Monday he still expects the gold miner to report a net profit of between A$20 million and A$25 million for the year ending June 30, 1997.
".... Goldfields is currently forecasting a profit after tax for 1996/97 within the range of A$20 million to A$25 million," he told the annual meeting.
Cotton said this forecast is subject to the many vagaries of the mining industry and is particularly dependent on the performance of the Porgera gold mine in Papua New Guinea.
Goldfields initially issued the profit forecast in late August when it reported a A$14.19 million net profit for 1995/96.
The company previously forecast a net profit of between A$30 million and A$46 million for 1996/97 in its formal takeover bid for Pancontinental Mining Ltd.

Cotton said reasons for the lower forecast were higher operating costs at 25 percent-owned Porgera and at the Henty gold mine in Tasmania, along with higher borrowings and hence increased interest charges.
